infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: GifMe needs camera access so you can snap a selfie to turn into GIFs.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: GifMe reads photos from your library so you can pick a selfie to turn into GIFs, and saves generated GIFs back to your library.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: GifMe saves your generated GIFs to your photo library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow GifMe to use your camera to take selfies.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow GifMe to save GIFs to your photo library.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow GifMe to save GIFs to your photo library.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow GifMe to pick a selfie from your photo library.
